Winter_Garden.name: Crimson
Winter_Garden.description:
A delicate, romantic pastel pink designed to bring a soft, youthful flush to the lips. It offers full-pigment coverage with a smooth, velvety matte texture that sits comfortably all day.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a soft, clean, light neutral grey with a slight pastel warmth.

The True Tone: It is a bright, low-saturation pink. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits firmly at a 75% lightness level (a bright, soft highlight tone). It provides a gentle, low-contrast lift against natural lip tones without appearing deep or dark.
